concerns.location: tasks.md:T106/T109/T110 vs spec.md:Edge Cases and constitution.md:Principle VII
concerns.text: T106 flags adapter records with injected_state='neutral-monitoring' as exclude_from_stats:true and T109/T110 filter them from the primary comparison. The spec's edge case says the neutral fallback exists to keep 'the static baseline comparison remain valid' — i.e., the neutral-monitoring run IS the valid adapter behavior for that trajectory, not a discardable record. One-sided post-hoc exclusion of adapter runs only breaks the paired design mandated by Constitution VII (same trajectories, same LLM, both conditions). No spec clause authorizes excluding these records from the primary effect.

The contract declares additionalProperties:false, requires consensus_gap_score (number) and injected_state (string). T106 adds confidence_score and exclude_from_stats fields (forbidden), T105/T106 write logs before scores exist (T109 computes them later), and T106 sets injected_state:null for static records while the schema types it as a required string. Every log T105/T106 produces would fail schema validation as specified — the tasks silently violate the contract instead of updating it.

SC-002 (verify the SoCRATES dataset contains the required emotional-reactivity and cultural-identity variables) has no implementing task; the coverage table lists SC-003 and SC-005 but omits SC-002 entirely. A success criterion has been silently dropped.

T112 validates classifier_training_data.json against trajectory.schema.yaml, but T103's records (trajectory_id, turn_text, label, confidence_score, threshold_used) do not conform to the trajectory schema's required fields (dialogue, metadata, ideal_resolution). The validation task is specified to fail against its own input — a contract/task contradiction.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Revision behavior vs plan.md:T028b and spec.md:US-2 Acceptance Scenario 1
concerns.text: Plan T028b (validate logged injected_state matches the injected instruction template, satisfying US-2 Acceptance Scenario 1) was consolidated away with no surviving equivalent in T101–T114. The template-match validation acceptance criterion has no task delivering it; the revision note 'No test or constraint was weakened' is inaccurate.

data-model.md specifies filtered_trajectories.jsonl with dialogue_history and emotional_reactivity_score (0.0–1.0) and experiment logs at data/results/experiment_logs/{model}/{condition}.jsonl, while T101/T106 write trajectories.jsonl with dialogue/emotional_reactivity (0–10) and aggregate to data/processed/experiment_logs.json. Entity names, scales, and paths disagree across artifacts; either the data model or the tasks must be reconciled so the SSoT is unambiguous.

US-1 Scenario 2 requires generation to complete within 30 minutes within memory capacity on a CPU runner; no task measures or asserts generation runtime/memory (T107 covers only experiment inference). The acceptance criterion survives in the spec but has no verification step in any task.
